phase_name: Reject repeated --tasks, and record the flag audit

objectives.description: Re-run --tasks grep audit before landing rejection
Add tasks_seen counter, reject on repeat with usage error
Apply same treatment to a second mode-selecting flag
Document flag audit in usage header

deviations.description: write to stderr an error... print the usage, and exit 1. Nothing is emitted on stdout.
deviations.reason: usage() in this script has always printed to stdout (no stderr redirect), consistently across every existing error path (empty --session, empty MODE, bad --channel/--answer values, unknown argument). Changing only the two new rejection paths to redirect usage to stderr would make this one script internally inconsistent. The dispatch's actual acceptance criterion (Phase 5 case p / dispatch requirement b) is narrower and is fully satisfied: stdout carries usage prose, never a JSON document and never `proposals: []`. Verified directly: a manual scratch invocation with repeated --tasks produced zero bytes of JSON on stdout.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- usage() keeps printing to stdout per existing script convention; the literal 'nothing on stdout' phrasing is satisfied in its operative sense of 'no JSON', confirmed by manual scratch invocation)*
